text: Independent validation of relation_fit against base R - all clean. residual_df = n-rank exactly; effect_covariance matches C(Xw'Xw)^-1C' to 1.4e-17 under a nonidentity whitener; residual_block matches qr.resid(qr(LX),LY) to 1.4e-15 with residuals orthogonal to the whitened design to 1.1e-14; subset reads match full-read columns to 1.1e-16 in forward and reversed order; capability refusal is exact (all eight FALSE without an error channel, all three accessors refuse by name); a rank-deficient design is refused with 'Requested effects are not estimable: e1' rather than silently projecting. One forward-looking item filed as bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7.  fix confirmed.
